commitResults.messageTitle: Rename Duke to AgentCT, and change ASCII-art banner
Update the initial code to simply greet the user and exit
Update the code to echo commands entered by the user, and exit when the user types the command bye
Add the ability to store whatever text the user enters and display it back when requested
Step 1: Implement the mark command to update task status, without using additional classes
Step 2: Implement the unmark command to update task status, without using additional classes
Apply Java coding standard to starter classes
commitResults.messageBody:
The starter classes need consistent package organization and
encapsulation to follow the project coding standard.

Add the project package, make task state private, use a descriptive
constant name, and document the main entry point.

The project needs a consistent coding standard for future Java
changes.

Require the SE-EDU Java standard for all new and modified code.

commitResults.messageTitle: Mandate project standards in Claude guidance
commitResults.messageBody: Claude guidance should explicitly direct future work to the\nproject-specific Git and Java standards.

Document the requirement to review the UI test plan and invoke the project-local test-ui skill after code updates. Add the reusable runner and initial console UI test plan so sessions produce comparable transcripts and stop on the first failure.
Support todos, deadlines, and events while preserving date and time values as strings. Update list and confirmation output and record the console verification scenario.
Move todo, deadline, and event behavior into Task subclasses while keeping the task list polymorphic. Preserve the existing command output and timing text.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java packages with source paths
commitResults.messageBody: Move the chatbot classes under the directory that matches their declared package so IntelliJ and Java tooling resolve them consistently. Rename the package from ip to chatbot to reflect the application identity and avoid package-path warnings. Update the console test plan and launch command, then record the Java 25 verification run.

Separate command-loop control from application startup in AgentCT. This keeps main focused on initializing the chatbot and delegates the lower-level input-processing details to a dedicated method.

Preserve the existing command behavior and console output while making future command-processing changes easier to understand and maintain.

Separate command parsing and task updates from the input-loop control in AgentCT. This gives each method a clearer abstraction level and makes the command-processing logic easier to extend independently.

Preserve the existing console output and task-count behavior while reducing the responsibilities of runCommandLoop.

Replace the fixed-size Task array and separate task-count bookkeeping with an ArrayList. This removes the arbitrary 100-task limit and keeps the collection size synchronized automatically.

Preserve the existing task commands and console output while making task storage easier to extend and reducing manual state management.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate exit handling from task count
commitResults.messageBody:
Handle the bye command directly in the command loop instead of using -1 as a sentinel task count. This keeps taskCount exclusively meaningful as the number of stored tasks and makes session termination explicit.

Preserve the existing goodbye output and command behavior while clarifying the responsibilities of the command-processing method.

Move task-list output formatting out of processCommand and into a dedicated method. This keeps command dispatch focused on selecting an operation and isolates the presentation details of listing tasks.

Preserve the existing list output while making future changes to task display easier to implement and review.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add error handling for invalid inputs and todo commands without a description

commitResults.messageBody: Reflect the intentional removal of echoed commands and add coverage for invalid commands and todo commands without descriptions. Keep expected transcripts aligned with the current separator output.
Reject blank todo, deadline, and event descriptions and trim accepted task fields. Improve invalid-command guidance and extend the console UI test plan for the new validation behavior.
Introduce AgentCTException for invalid commands and missing task descriptions. Catch these errors at the command-loop boundary so the chatbot reports them and continues accepting input.
Add interleaved valid and invalid command scenarios with complete expected transcripts. Verify that malformed commands and invalid task numbers do not alter the chatbot's task state.
